public_body: Nahant Public Library Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing and voting on a topic not listed on the April 1 notice, though the Chair anticipated it 48+ hours earlier. The AG declined to review a minutes allegation raised first at the AG stage.

allegations.summary: Board discussed and voted on a letter documenting a library director's alleged misconduct, a topic not listed on the April 1 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that Chair Dolan anticipated more than 48 hours prior to the Board's April 1 meeting that the Board would discuss how to address certain allegations against Ms. Montgomery.

allegations.summary: Request for further review alleged the April 1 minutes omit certain discussions; this was not in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, we decline to review any allegations raised for the first time in the May 28 letter to our office.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Review the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Video #2: Meeting Notices and certify to the AG's office within thirty (30) days of the letter, using the attached form.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.

source.publisher_filename: DETERMINATION - 9 25 2015 - OML 2015-141 - NAHANT PUBLIC LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES.pdf

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
